activities.name: Configure Cluster Monitoring and Alerting
activities.description: Customize Prometheus monitoring stack with application metrics and SLO-based alerts.

narratives.name: Configure Cluster Monitoring Technique
narratives.description: OpenShift integrated monitoring requires customization for application metrics and SLO alerting.

narrativeContexts.context: OpenShift includes integrated Prometheus, Grafana, and AlertManager, requiring customization for application metrics and SLO-based alerting.

Enable user workload monitoring via ConfigMap with enableUserWorkload:true. Create ServiceMonitor custom resources matching application Service labels. Define PrometheusRule resources with PromQL queries for alert conditions following symptom-based alerting. Configure AlertManagerConfig to route critical alerts to PagerDuty, warnings to Slack. Implement alert grouping via group_wait and group_interval.

Avoid monitoring the monitoring stack itself without proper separation. Alert fatigue occurs when using cause-based alerts instead of symptom-based alerts. Test alert routing regularly using amtool alert add. Review alert fatigue quarterly.

activities.name: Configure Distributed Tracing
activities.description: Deploy OpenTelemetry and Tempo for request tracing across microservices.

narratives.name: Configure Distributed Tracing Technique
narratives.description: Distributed tracing addresses observability challenges in microservices architectures.

narrativeContexts.context: Distributed tracing addresses observability challenges in microservices architectures where requests traverse multiple services.

Install OpenShift Distributed Tracing Platform operator. For production, deploy Tempo with object storage backend. Configure sampling rates balancing trace volume with observability needs. Integrate OpenTelemetry SDKs in application code or enable automatic instrumentation via service mesh. Deploy OpenTelemetry Collector as DaemonSets. Enable Traces UI via Cluster Observability Operator enhanced UI plugin.
Avoid 100% sampling in production. Ensure trace context propagation across all service calls including message queues. Limit span attribute cardinality to prevent storage bloat.

activities.description: Deploy OpenShift Logging operator and configure log forwarding to external destinations.

narratives.name: Deploy Centralized Logging Technique
narratives.description: Centralized logging aggregates logs from all pods for troubleshooting and compliance.

narrativeContexts.context: Centralized logging aggregates logs from all pods, infrastructure, and audit sources, enabling troubleshooting and compliance.

Install OpenShift Logging operator. Create ClusterLogging custom resource specifying collector configuration. Configure ClusterLogForwarder defining outputs. Use per-output proxy configuration. Enable Workload Identity Federation for Google Cloud. Apply log retention policies. Implement filtering pipelines. Encourage structured logging.
Avoid logging sensitive data. Prevent log volume explosion through filtering. Ensure retention meets compliance requirements. Test log forwarding regularly.

activities.name: Instrument Applications with Metrics
activities.description: Integrate Prometheus client libraries into applications to expose custom metrics.

narratives.name: Instrument Applications Technique
narratives.description: Application instrumentation adds custom metrics for business-level KPIs.

narrativeContexts.context: Application instrumentation adds custom metrics to expose business-level KPIs and technical performance indicators.

Integrate Prometheus client library. Expose metrics at /metrics endpoint. Create ServiceMonitor custom resource. Follow metric naming conventions. Implement RED metrics. Use histogram metrics for latency percentiles.
Avoid high-cardinality metric labels. Focus on user-facing behavior not internal implementation details. Ensure metric endpoints are efficient. Test ServiceMonitor discovery.

activities.name: Deploy Cluster Observability Operator
activities.description: Deploy Cluster Observability Operator for multi-tenant observability stacks.

narratives.name: Deploy Cluster Observability Operator Technique
narratives.description: Cluster Observability Operator provides multi-tenant observability with independent Prometheus instances.

narrativeContexts.context: Cluster Observability Operator provides multi-tenant observability with independent Prometheus instances, retention policies, and alert management per team.

Install Cluster Observability Operator. Create MonitoringStack custom resources per tenant. Configure RBAC per tenant. Enable federated queries. Deploy enhanced UI plugin for signal correlation. Integrate OpenShift Lightspeed for AI-assisted analysis. Enable network observability and power monitoring.

Avoid excessive tenant stacks increasing resource consumption. Ensure tenant-level retention balances costs with troubleshooting needs. Configure cost allocation metrics. Test federated queries for correct scoping.

activities.name: Define SLIs and SLOs
activities.description: Define Service Level Indicators and Objectives aligned to customer experience.

narratives.name: Define SLIs and SLOs Technique
narratives.description: SRE practices define SLIs and SLOs to align observability with customer experience.

narrativeContexts.context: SRE practices define SLIs as quantitative measures of service behavior and SLOs as target ranges to align observability with customer experience.

Identify customer-facing metrics. Define SLIs as quantifiable measures. Agree SLOs with stakeholders. Calculate error budget. Implement symptom-based alerting on error budget burn rate. Configure dashboards displaying SLI trends. Document runbooks. Track toil metrics.

Avoid defining SLIs based on infrastructure metrics instead of user-facing behavior. Do not set SLOs without stakeholder agreement. Ensure error budgets are consumed when violated. Review SLOs quarterly.

activities.name: Establish Observability Culture
activities.description: Build team understanding of observability pillars, shared alerting responsibility, and dashboard practices.

narratives.name: Establish Observability Culture Technique
narratives.description: Establishing observability culture ensures collective understanding of the three pillars.

narrativeContexts.context: Establishing observability culture ensures the team collectively understands the three pillars of observability and shares responsibility for monitoring and alerting.

Conduct training sessions on metrics, logs, and traces pillars. Establish shared on-call rotations for alert response. Implement dashboard review cadences to reduce alert fatigue. Create observability standards for new applications.
Avoid siloing observability knowledge in one person. Ensure all team members can create and modify dashboards. Regularly review alert noise levels to prevent fatigue.

activities.name: Enable Log Search and Correlation
activities.description: Configure log indexing, search capabilities, and correlation with metrics and traces.

narratives.name: Enable Log Search and Correlation Technique
narratives.description: Log search and correlation capabilities transform raw log data into actionable resources.

narrativeContexts.context: Log search and correlation capabilities transform raw log data into an actionable troubleshooting and analysis resource.

Configure log search UI via Kibana, Grafana, or vendor tooling. Implement log filtering pipelines to drop non-essential data. Enable structured logging for improved parsing. Configure log-based metrics extraction for trending. Inject trace_id into application logs for trace-log correlation.
Avoid indexing all log fields which causes storage explosion. Ensure sensitive data redaction before indexing. Test log search performance under production volumes.

patternViews.name: Prerequisites - Metrics Foundation
patternViews.description: Built-in Prometheus provides initial cluster visibility.

narrativeContexts.context: OpenShift includes integrated Prometheus monitoring stack providing immediate cluster and workload visibility without additional deployment. Team identified and assigned to observability responsibilities.

patternViews.name: Crawl - Centralized Logging and Custom Metrics
patternViews.description: Deploy logging stack and implement application instrumentation.

narrativeContexts.context: Deploy OpenShift Logging with forwarding, instrument applications with Prometheus client libraries, create custom Grafana dashboards for application KPIs.
Logs forwarded to external destinations enable troubleshooting, custom metrics expose business-level indicators, team develops shared understanding of three observability pillars.

patternViews.name: Walk - SLO-Based Alerting and Log Analysis
patternViews.description: Define Service Level Objectives and enable log search capabilities.

narrativeContexts.context: SLIs defined for customer-facing metrics, SLOs agreed with stakeholders, error budgets tracked. Logs fully searchable with filtering and correlation. Distributed tracing platform deployed.
Symptom-based alerts replace cause-based alerts, reducing alert fatigue. Log-based metrics provide trending insights. Team adopts SRE practices with error budget management.

patternViews.name: Run - Distributed Tracing and Multi-Tenancy
patternViews.description: Full tracing instrumentation and initial multi-tenant observability.

narrativeContexts.context: Distributed tracing captures request flows across microservices with full application instrumentation. Cluster Observability Operator provides per-team monitoring stacks.
Trace analysis identifies performance bottlenecks. Multi-tenant isolation enables team autonomy with independent retention and alerting policies.

patternViews.name: Optimize - Unified AI-Enhanced Platform
patternViews.description: Signal correlation, AI analysis, and self-service observability.

narrativeContexts.context: Enhanced UI plugin correlates metrics, logs, and traces in unified console view. Teams self-serve dashboards and alerts via GitOps.
Signal correlation enables single-pane-of-glass troubleshooting. Network observability reveals flow patterns. Power monitoring tracks sustainability metrics.
OpenShift Lightspeed AI-assisted trace analysis automatically identifies bottlenecks and suggests optimizations. Self-service observability transforms platform teams from bottlenecks to enablers.
